Definition: Integration of health records, patient registration, immunization data, and health insurance into data exchange
Comments: The eGabon CI-SIS (Clinical Information System Interoperability Framework) was developed under the eGabon-SIS project (launched 2016). A Strategic Master Plan for the National Health Information System (SDSSIS, 2017) and an eHealth interoperability framework were developed, including use cases for patient admission, laboratory, imaging, health surveillance, and patient identifier (ISG). The project reached a pilot phase by 2021. The CNAM-GS (National Health Insurance and Social Security Fund) is a major data system. Full integration with the broader government data exchange layer is not confirmed.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Gabon has strong infrastructure: 94% of population covered by 3G/4G (ARCEP/GSMA 2020), 1.919 million Internet subscribers (June 2020), and a national fiber-optic backbone of 1,030 km. However, the World Bank Digital Gabon Project ISR explicitly targets a rural-to-overall NIP coverage ratio of 1.0 (baseline 0.0), acknowledging a rural-urban gap. The World Bank DE4A diagnostic notes persistent digital exclusion in rural areas.
